title: Prove exact three-swap corank-one pivot bound (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. For every field and every m>=4, the optimal worst-case pivot-swap count for rank-(m-1) projectors in the paid BIT fallback is exactly three:

```text
PR4245: finite corank-one optima; uniform statement open
Here:   s*(m,m-1)=3, with a constructive policy and matching family
```

A single column transposition bridges all bad principal minors once the last coordinate product is nonzero. When necessary, two paid preparatory swaps establish that condition at a legal pivot stage. Both swap directions, prescribed stages and clearing ADDs remain charged. A three-coordinate rank-one defect plus identity coordinates proves the matching obstruction over every field, including characteristic two.

This answers PR4245 Open next question 1. Its finite census and PR4235's fallback, weighted-adapter, full-ring and dirty-restoration contracts are cited predecessors, not audit deliverables. No predecessor executable or census is replayed. Credit Nick Petalas for those predecessors and this contribution; Cinna Davis / PR4100, source527, commdata2338, Jose Manuel and Ross Richardson retain their block-identity, normalizer and recursive/orientation credit. Determinant identities and Gaussian elimination are classical.

## Evidence

The new policy passes literal elimination in both equal-head and original reversed-tail conventions on all 20,595 projectors in seven complete parameter domains: F2 at m=2,...,7 and F3 at m=5. A separate iterative search excludes every legal plan costing at most two for 36 sharp-family members over F2,F3,F5,F7 at m=4,...,12, visiting 576 states. Another 72 fixtures reach m=64. Nine rejection controls and three semantic comparisons pass. The written proof supplies the universal quantifiers.

From the repository root, using standard-library CPython 3.12.15 locally:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/corank-one-pivot-policy/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/corank-one-pivot-policy/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/corank-one-pivot-policy
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/corank-one-pivot-policy --check-source-history
```

All pass locally at `050281f3d15f16a1a4e14454d168ba4d9e274894`. Direct normal and optimized checks took 0.88 and 0.73 seconds; both registered modes have 120-second limits. Output includes `PASS_CORANK_ONE_PIVOT_POLICY`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Generated receipts bind all seven package files. Official committed export/input integrity and a Git-free optimized exported replay also pass. Warning-strict execution and AST function-size inspection pass. No generated files remain in the checkout.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The executable supports prime fields through 31 and dimensions through 64; the proof covers every field and all m>=4. The policy is worst-case optimal; pointwise minimum cost is not claimed. The odd-prime-power-ring consequence uses PR4235's residue itinerary and split-projector lifting as cited premises.

At m=64 corank one has rank 63, outside the retained paid boundary r<=42. No selected-boundary worst-packet improvement, new kappa, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem follows. Higher corank, actual physical packet installation, coefficient preparation, routing, dirty restoration, stock, precision, tape and outer costs remain open. Selected scientific cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can a rank-two defect admit a constructive 2(m-r)+2 swap bound? Its mixed minors need a replacement for the single mismatch interval.
- Can an actual corank-one packet use this policy profitably after coefficient extraction, full-ring clearing, weighted swaps, tape routes and dirty restoration are priced?

## Related open work

The refreshed account open-PR list contains no other PR created since the advance CLAIM that studies this stage-ordered corank-one pivot-policy count. The earlier complete open-PR scan also found none. Merged PR4245 poses the question and PR4235 supplies the fallback contract. Recent shear-swap tariffs and minor-probability work study different quantities; no numerical comparison or additional replay is asserted.

This CI result certifies the registered replay, not independent mathematical acceptance of the written proof.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: one isolated research package. Selected-frontier files, shared code and frozen predecessor packages are unchanged.
